metadata.context: A549 OPS reporter atlas; held-out gene evaluation; coherent ten-method median ensemble
metadata.aggregation: Recovery: fivefold mean of ensemble endpoint-macro Pearson. Response metrics: aligned out-of-fold ensemble predictions, summarized per reporter.
metadata.boundary: These are frozen target–predictor–context decisions at the manuscript's OPS/A549 reference operating point, not universal properties of a reporter.
metadata.domainSensitivity: A separately reported domain-transfer flag, not an additional tier criterion.
metadata.goBPDefinition: Jaccard overlap between the top ten measured and predicted Gene Ontology biological-process terms after response replacement.

oasis.context: OASIS primary human hepatocytes; independently held-out compounds
oasis.lossDefinition: Signed metabolic loss relative to same-plate DMSO, averaged over eight concentrations after frozen well/source aggregation.
oasis.uncertainty: Comparison recall intervals: deposited 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 compound-bootstrap samples.
oasis.interpretation: Retention of strongly metabolically injurious compounds at a fixed 5% selection budget. This use-specific analysis is distinct from broad response-fidelity classification.
oasis.inputContext: Released 768-feature brightfield-channel DINO representation from fixed, stained acquisitions; fluorescence-derived cell counts are separate diagnostic comparator inputs.
